did: The weekly call's routine now says home takes a re-stamp of a week with no video within an hour, and never once a part has its video. A part of the call that falls inside one long section now gets chapters, from each item it holds, so Nov 6's part 2 can have its description. Where YouTube's rules leave a part none, the recorder says so in its log instead of staying quiet. On the way, the commit check learned to read promise names longer than four letters, such as SFEED4.

calls.title: How a part inside one section gets its chapters
options: each item opens a chapter only when the sections make fewer than three
every item of every section always opens its own chapter
a section's chapter slide repeated every few items
calls.why: It fixes the parts that had none and leaves every whole week's chapters exactly as they were.
calls.undo: Drop the finer item marks in the call's chapter marks, and a one-section part has no chapters again, with the log saying so.

left: Nov 6's part 2 still has no description on home: it needs a re-render or its chapters written from its kept scene times, which only home can do.
The policy-docs check still reads a declared invariant's name as at most four letters; no such longer name is declared yet, and it was raised to the coordinator.
